kit.title: COGNOS EMERGENCY KIT
kit.intro:
Your Account Key is the only thing that can unlock your data.
Store it somewhere safe and private — a password manager, or printed and
locked away. Anyone who has it can read your chats.
kit.what:
What it does:
- Unlocks your encrypted chats on a new device.
- Your password only signs you in; this key unlocks your data.
kit.lose:
If you lose it:
- We keep no copy of your Account Key, so your data cannot be recovered.

kit.title: Account Key & Emergency Kit
kit.description: Your Account Key unlocks your encrypted data. Download a fresh copy of your Emergency Kit or copy the key while your data is unlocked.
kit.lockedBody: Your data is locked on this device. Unlock it first, then you can download your Emergency Kit here.
kit.unavailableTitle: Your Account Key isn't kept on this device
kit.unavailableBody: For your security we never keep a copy of your Account Key after you unlock. Keep the Emergency Kit you saved when you signed up — it's the only way to unlock your data on a new device.

bookmarks.title: Your bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Highlights you've saved from your chats. They're stored encrypted — jump back to a message or remove one.
bookmarks.empty: You haven’t saved any bookmarks yet. Highlight text in a chat and choose “Save to bookmarks”.
bookmarks.removeError: Couldn't remove the bookmark. Please try again.

welcome.title: What would you like to do first?
welcome.body: Choose a starting point, or skip this and write your own message.

think.title: Think through something privately
think.description: Work through a decision one question at a time.
think.prompt: Help me think through a decision. Ask me one question at a time, and do not assume details I have not shared.

draft.title: Draft or improve something
draft.description: Shape a clear piece of writing for its audience.
draft.prompt: Help me draft or improve a piece of writing. Ask who it is for, what it needs to achieve and the tone I want.

plan.title: Plan my next steps
plan.description: Turn a goal into a practical, realistic plan.
plan.prompt: Help me turn a goal into practical next steps. Ask about my deadline and constraints first.

trust.title: Before you send:
trust.persisted: Your Conversation is stored encrypted. To generate a reply, Cognos and your selected Provider process the Messages in readable form during the request.
trust.detail: After the reply is generated, Message content is encrypted for storage. Use Redaction before sending when you want detected sensitive values replaced on this device.

a11y.starterAdded: Starter added to the message box. Review it before sending.

habit.title: Your first week with Cognos
habit.body: A few gentle suggestions. Your Message content is never used to measure progress.
habit.returnRecent: Come back to a recent Conversation next week

import.title: Bring your Conversations to Cognos
import.subtitle: Review and select supported history before it is encrypted and saved.
import.trustTitle: Your raw export stays on this device.
import.trustBody: It is read locally and is not uploaded to Cognos. Imported history is sent to a Provider only if you later continue that Conversation.
import.sourceBody: Choose a source to see the right export instructions.

chatgpt.title: Export from ChatGPT
chatgpt.body: ChatGPT provides a ZIP containing conversations.json.
chatgpt.step1: In ChatGPT, open Settings, then Data controls.
chatgpt.step2: Choose Export data and confirm the request.
chatgpt.step3: Download the ZIP from the email when it is ready, then select it below.

claude.title: Export from Claude
claude.body: Claude provides an account data export containing your chat history.
claude.step1: On the Claude web or desktop app, open Settings, then Privacy.
claude.step3: Download the export from the email when it is ready, then select it below.

import.limit: ZIP or JSON, up to 250 MB. Attachments, images and tool records are reported but not imported in this version.

progress.reading: Reading the export on this device…
progress.validated: The archive is safe to open. Reading Conversations…
progress.encrypting: Encrypting and saving the selected Conversations…

errors.title: We could not complete this import.
errors.invalid_json: The JSON is malformed. Request a new export and try again.
errors.unsupported_schema: This export format is not supported. Request a current export from the selected source.
errors.too_large: This export exceeds the safe import limit.
errors.too_deep: This export is nested too deeply to process safely.
errors.persistence_failed: The encrypted import could not be saved. Nothing from the current Conversation was stored; please try again.

preview.title: Review before importing
preview.summary: {{ conversations }} Conversations and {{ messages }} Messages are ready to review.
preview.unsupported: Not imported: {{ attachments }} attachments, {{ images }} images, {{ tools }} tool records and {{ other }} other items.
preview.persistencePending: Nothing is uploaded until you confirm. Cognos receives only encrypted Conversation data.

errors.createBackup: Something went wrong creating your encrypted backup. Please try again.
errors.unlock: That Account Key didn't match, so we couldn't unlock your data. Check it and try again.

policies.heading: Policies
policies.subtitle: Rules that apply to everyone working in this Organisation's Projects.
policies.privacyHint: Caps which models members can use in this Organisation's Projects. If a member's own region setting is narrower, the narrower one applies.
policies.retentionHint: New conversations in this Organisation's Projects are deleted permanently after this many days. Enter 0 for no automatic deletion. If a conversation has a shorter auto-delete of its own, the shorter one applies.
policies.retentionError: Enter a whole number of days (0 or more).
policies.mfaHint: Members without two-factor authentication are blocked from this Organisation's Projects until they enable it in their security settings.
policies.mfaWarning: This takes effect as soon as you save: members without two-factor authentication immediately lose access to this Organisation's Projects until they enable it. Let your team know before switching this on.

accept.title: Join an Organisation
accept.intro: Paste the invite token you received, or open the invite link from your email.
accept.error: That invite didn't work. It may have expired or already been used — check the link, or paste the token again below.
accept.sameAccount: You joined with the Cognos account you already have — same sign-in, same Account Key, no new Emergency Kit.
accept.billingNote: Work in {{ org }} Projects is billed to the organisation. Your personal chats stay yours and stay billed to you.
accept.switchHint: Use the workspace switcher in the sidebar to open {{ org }}.
